title: Where agents get paid
description: Current earning-related list, alphabetical, with source-visit dates. Numeric legacy money rows are not served here.

generated_at.description: Time of the newest data in this build, ISO 8601 UTC: the later of source_snapshot_at and newest_observation, so it moves when a newer overview visit is recorded (since schema_version 1.9.0; before, it was the source snapshot time alone).

source_snapshot_at.description: Time the source data snapshot file was produced, ISO 8601 UTC (what generated_at held before schema_version 1.9.0).
